releases.synopsis: Rise of the Rockstar Chef charts the rise of three of Britain's most influential culinary figures, Marco Pierre White, Gordon Ramsay and Heston Blumenthal, whose drive, creativity and uncompromising pursuit of excellence helped transform modern British cuisine and placed it firmly on the global stage.This series is set against the backdrop of the ‘Cool Britannia' era of radical social and cultural change. The episodes will explore how the chefs' unwavering ambition and intense rivalry reshaped Britain's restaurant industry and redefined what it meant to be a fine dining chef, ultimately inspiring a generation around the world.Featuring candid testimony from the trio themselves, as well as those who witnessed the fights, fall-outs and feuds first-hand, including renowned food critics, maîtres d' and former commis chefs, the story culminates in an extraordinary on-screen reunion that brings the three chefs together for the first time in decades to revisit defining moments and confront the legacy of an era that reshaped British dining.

As he investigates the truth behind his mother's disappearance, a series of conspiracies gradually surface. Witness Su Beitian overcome tribulations, unravel the ultimate martial arts, and become the supreme master of alchemy!

releases.title: When I Meet the Moon

However, amid the loving moments, their differing perspectives eventually lead to a breakup. When she goes abroad, his deeply suppressed trauma is brought to the forefront. To win her back, he gets back on his feet, leading his team to new heights in scientific research. When she returns to China, he pursues her relentlessly, and the two overcome their differences and rekindle their love.

releases.title: Till I See You

But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?

releases.title: Love Island Australia: Unseen. Uncut

releases.title: The Palace Gambit
releases.synopsis: Two sisters are summoned to the imperial court. The elder is a woman of peerless beauty, the younger a quick-witted charmer. Seeking only a peaceful existence, they instead find themselves the targets of deadly schemes with no escape in sight. Forging an unstoppable alliance, they win the Emperor's favor within months. But at the peak of their glory, the elder sister, carrying the imperial heir, meets a tragic end. Overnight, their favor vanishes. Now, the younger sister, Lu Jiuning, buries her hatred and, from her lowly position as a palace maid, challenges the entire harem. She maneuvers among the consorts and stands firm before the Emperor, setting her meticulous plans for revenge. This battle is not for favor, but for blood!

releases.title: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle
releases.synopsis: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle, utilizing her extensive Wall Street background to analyze the high-stakes intersection of money, power, and politics, Stephanie Ruhle delivers original reporting and hard-hitting interviews on the stories that directly affect Americans' lives. The program focuses on business and political news, featuring the "Nightcap" roundtable segment from her previous show, The 11th Hour

releases.title: Big Day with Peter Schrager
releases.synopsis: Big Day with Peter Schrager will originate from New York City and cover the biggest stories from across the sports world each day, blending reporting, interviews, unique perspectives and authentic conversations with the athletes, coaches, executives and personalities driving the day's biggest headlines. While fans can expect Schrager's trademark NFL insight and relationships, Big Day is built to celebrate the full sports landscape and the moments everyone will be talking about.

releases.title: Classic Movies: The Story of...
releases.synopsis: Classic Movies: The Story of... goes in search of the cinematically sublime. Those films that have transcended their era to enter the pantheon of greats.With each episode devoted to a single film, their story will be told with detail, affection, looking for the truth behind the myth, all the trials and triumphs that went into forging a classic. But this isn't simply history, the standard making of, it's about identifying those ingredients immortal scenes, performances, themes, luxuriant cinematography, art direction, special effects, music, even the power of a single line – that elevate a film to a new level.Hosted by Ian Nathan, guide us through the story from inception to legacy, supplemented with regular input along with special guest, with unique insight, historians who have devoted entire books, and visit to special location, where they shot or that served as  a key inspiration, bringing each of these films to life with a dynamic presentation. We are on a journey to find out not what makes a film good, but what makes it classic.

releases.title: Wherever Whoever Whatever

releases.title: The Price Is Right
releases.synopsis: "Come on down!" The Price Is Right features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items.

releases.title: Northern Storm
releases.synopsis: In the late 1970s, Liu Haizhu, a young man from Songliao, intervenes to uphold justice and is swept into a jianghu conflict, where he forges a bond of life and death with Dong Batian. Through shifting times, he moves from an ordinary worker to a man entangled in the underworld, navigating brotherhood, tangled love and hate, and moral choices. He ultimately finds self-growth and redemption amid the ice and black soil.

releases.title: Зрадники
releases.synopsis: The show "Traitors" is an adaptation of the world hit The Traitors. The Ukrainian reality show features 22 participants competing for half a million hryvnias. Among them are "loyal" and "traitors". The task of the "loyal" is to expose the traitors, and the traitors - to reach the final. The action takes place in the Schönborn castle.

releases.title: Big John's Bosh! Family
releases.synopsis: The series follows internet sensation John "Big John" Fisher and his wife Charlotte, the heart and backbone of the Fisher household, alongside their children, including rising boxing star Johnny "The Romford Bull", city boy William, and their youngest and only daughter, Hetty. Not forgetting 'Fat Nan' and 'Skinny Nan.' Across six episodes, Big John's Bosh! Family throws open the doors to the wonderfully chaotic world of Big John and the Fisher clan. Juggling viral fame, family milestones, and fresh adventures, life for the family is anything but ordinary. With big characters, bigger laughs and plenty of surprises along the way including appearances from celebrity friends Joe Marler, Eddie Hearn, Dana White and Joey Essex, the series offers an unfiltered glimpse into the chaos, comedy and heart that have turned Big John and the Fishers into an international phenomenon.

releases.title: Pinoy Big Brother
releases.synopsis: The Philippine adaptation of the reality game show "Big Brother" features Filipino housemates live together, share their stories and build meaningful relationships as they do tasks and challenges supervised by Big Brother. Every week a nomination is done, and the public decides who gets evicted and eventually become the Big Winner of the program.

releases.title: Dreams of Freedom

releases.title: On the Line with Alicia Menendez

releases.title: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan
releases.synopsis: In a city experiencing a spiritual resurgence, demons threaten to invade. Qin Yu, a boy born with a useless spiritual root, unexpectedly awakens divine power within him and is chosen to inherit the mysterious and powerful cultivation technique, "The Life-Giving Power of All Things." After joining the Dongda Martial Arts Academy, Qin Yu gradually befriends a group of chivalrous companions, cultivating and growing together to protect their school and their planet .

releases.title: The Silent Storm
releases.synopsis: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

releases.title: The Great Long March
releases.synopsis: Revolving around the arduous Long March of the Central Red Army, it documents the historical process—from the army's failure in the fifth counter-encirclement campaign, to the First, Second, Fourth Front Armies of the Red Army and the 25th Red Army launching strategic transfers under the leadership of the CPC Central Committee—to eventual triumph. It extols the unyielding ideals and revolutionary spirit of Mao Zedong and Chinese Communists, and elucidates the history and logic behind the rise and development of the Chinese revolution, proving that adapting Marxism to China's specific conditions was essential for victory.

releases.title: De Slimste Mens ter Wereld
releases.synopsis: Do we still sing the praises of folly like Erasmus, or is it trendy again to be smart? And if so, who is the smartest? Who can talk about the medals won at the Olympic Games in London, but at the same time knows who Captain Haddock is? Who knows whether Lacan was a hair growth product or a psychoanalyst and can also program their own digital television? Who has déjà vu when leafing through the Encyclopedia Britannica and when reading the interviews with the new Miss Waregem Koerse?  Who, oh who, is the smartest person in Flanders, Belgium, Europe, and by extension, the world? That is determined by a fierce battle between three fellow human beings. Every day, someone is eliminated, someone who may not be the smartest, but who is perhaps cherished in their family circle because of their many other talents. The others advance and are joined by a new challenger every day.

releases.title: Na Wspólnej

Na Wspólnej is a Polish soap opera. It has been running since 2003 on the TVN channel as its flagship primetime weekday soap opera. It is loosely based on the German production Unter Uns and it follows the lives of the inhabitants of an apartment block in Wspólna Street, Warsaw. Episodes tend to last around 20 minutes. It is a Polish version of the Hungarian "Barátok közt".

The series is shot almost entirely in Warsaw and produced by the Polish branch of Freemantle Media. On 9 September 2008 it celebrated its 1000th episode; "Na Wspólnej" was the fourth Polish television series ever to achieve such status. A special episode was broadcast in which characters from some other of TVN's most popular shows visited Wspólna Street.

releases.synopsis: It follows the tragic life of Giulia Cecchettin, starting from the private pain of her father, Gino Cecchettin, and culminating in a cinematic story that stems from the book of the victim's father, entitled Dear Giulia.

releases.title: Never Dies
releases.synopsis: Amidst imminent financial ruin, a debt-ridden man experiences profound relief upon discovering his estranged late father’s substantial life insurance policy—only to be thrown into an absurd moral crisis when the patriarch unexpectedly resuscitates inside the hearse en route to the funeral home.

releases.title: Married to the Filipino Mafia
releases.synopsis: Meet the Filipino Mafia Family.  “Blood is thicker than water. We’re happy to spill yours.”  Marrying into this family? Good luck.

releases.title: Overacting
releases.synopsis: When her father's memories as a retired top cop resurface, a struggling actress stages wild missions to keep him from pursuing his elusive archnemesis.

releases.title: La Esquina tá en Candela
releases.synopsis: When a man bursts into a grocery store armed and demanding to talk with somebody, an ordinary afternoon turns into chaos in the neighborhood.

releases.title: Norjack
releases.synopsis: In 1971 a Mystery Man Hijacks a Boeing 727 Aircraft.

releases.title: Drei Kameradinnen
releases.synopsis: Hani, Kasih and Saya have shared a deep friendship since their youth. Now, after years, the three meet again. But no matter where they are, it becomes clear time and again that everyday racism affects their lives. Nonetheless, their friendship gives them strength. Until one dramatic night shakes everything up.

releases.title: Snowbody Like You
releases.synopsis: A holiday first date ends in a frosty misunderstanding, leaving Peyton and Ethan to go their separate ways. Years later, a Christmas blizzard brings them back together, giving them one more chance to discover if the magic between them was meant to last.

releases.title: Idling
releases.synopsis: When Frank’s car breaks down in a bleak winter landscape, a mechanic named Barry comes to his aid. Hoping to repair the car, the two men take it into a labyrinthine underground parking garage governed by strange rules, where other unfortunate souls seem trapped.

releases.title: De souche
releases.synopsis: As immigration becomes more central than ever in political discourses, De souche offers a dizzying deep dive into the far-reaching tentacles of the “Great Replacement” conspiracy theory, which is gaining popularity across the Western world. In this illuminating documentary, journalist and filmmaker Simon Coutu travels across Québec and France, meeting a range of people who subscribe to or specialize in the subject. He examines the origins of this rhetoric, its harmful consequences, and its ties to the far right and white supremacist movements. A hard-hitting documentary that offers an essential critical perspective.

releases.title: Rambut Sewu: Satu Langkah Getih
releases.synopsis: Wulan moves to a village with her mother, Ratih. After working at a tea factory, they move into an old house owned by the company. From then on, Wulan begins to experience strange dreams and mysterious events, eventually losing control of herself. The villagers attribute these disturbances to Marni, a former resident of the house whose story has remained a mystery for decades. When Wulan’s story spreads on social media, Damar, a reporter and native son of the village, arrives to investigate. Suradi, who is aware of the powers of the past, comes to help. Together, they try to sever Wulan’s connection to Marni and the power of Dhandhang Gendhing.

releases.title: Kyiv. Day-Night
releases.synopsis: The beloved main cast of the cult classic TV series Kyiv. Day and Night decide to take a road trip, reopening the doors to the memories of the past.

releases.title: Ana, en passant
releases.synopsis: After her grandmother’s death, Ana finds herself adrift. Following the clues left by her late grandmother, Ana arrives in Belo Horizonte and meets Alice. As they make sense of the city’s layout and their memories, Ana and Alice will discover what it means to become who they are.

releases.title: Sandal Jepit No. 10
releases.synopsis: Akbar, a seemingly ordinary man, is taken into custody and interrogated regarding a serial murder case. From inside the room, he piece by piece reveals the timeline, underlying motives, and complex criminal plot through voice and narration alone.

releases.title: Terrell & T.O.
releases.synopsis: This feature-length documentary traces the meteoric rise of one of the most talented, accomplished, and polarizing athletes of America's most popular sport and examines his role as the preeminent "prima donna" wide receiver of his era, while catching up with Owens in present-day to see how he is evolving and discovering a new personal path forward.

releases.title: Aussie at Heart
releases.synopsis: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

releases.title: Gravy
releases.synopsis: Shust and his friends commit small-time scams for a living, taking advantage of any opportunity that comes their way. Meeting Ulyanov, the former Soviet Union shot put champion, and his daughter opens Shust's eyes to a completely different way of living. But under his gang's pressure, he uses Ulyanov to plan a heist on a Buryat jade-trading commune.

releases.title: The Nameless Ballad
releases.synopsis: Death is a powerful muse. Under pressure from his record label, a young musician in crisis takes refuge in an isolated Italian villa to find inspiration for his next album. But the discovery of an ancient piano and a forgotten diary drags him into a spiral of twisted obsessions, supernatural visions and ghostly presences that finally push him to the brink of madness.

releases.title: Block 10
releases.synopsis: In early 1943, at the Auschwitz main camp, hundreds of Jewish women are confined in cramped quarters in BLOCK 10, which is separated from the rest of the camp grounds. Nazi doctors subject them to the most painful methods of forced sterilization. Prisoner doctors are forced to collaborate. The Jewish gynecologist Dr. Maximilian Samuel is blackmailed with the gassing of his 20-year-old daughter if he refuses to participate in the brutal experiments. Caught in this moral dilemma, he seeks his own path.

releases.title: Un'altra me
releases.synopsis: A comedy about social newtorks.

releases.title: Precipice
releases.synopsis: A reckless group of teens on the run from the ever approaching future engage in a downward spiral of drug abuse, violence, and existentialism.

releases.title: Holofiction
releases.synopsis: The experimental film explores the visual representation of the Holocaust through a montage of thousands of excerpts from fictional films and television series produced between 1938 and the present. Drawing from an extensive archive of over 3,000 narrative works the film critically examines how Holocaust imagery has been codified and reproduced in cinema across decades.

releases.title: Лето в Бадене
releases.synopsis: A Soviet intellectual is engaged in science and medicine, writing for himself. His only son decides to leave the country forever, breaking his heart and ruining his career and social standing. Having lost everything, he decides to write a novel about Dostoevsky, the subject he's been dreaming about his whole life. Like his beloved writer, he must lose completely in order to be reborn.

releases.title: Sydney vs. Sean
releases.synopsis: SYDNEY VS SEAN follows Sydney, a red-carpet host chasing perfection, and Sean, a bisexual nurse clinging to independence. A hookup grows into a passionate but volatile romance. After a year apart, the turbulent day of their divorce signing ricochets between past and present. When their eccentric notary arrives, he witnesses two lovers confront a bond that can’t be sustained, yet refuses to fade. Starring JANEL PARRISH (Pretty Little Liars, "To All The Boys" Trilogy) , T.R. KNIGHT (Grey's Anatomy, The Flight Attendant), RYAN POWERS (She-Hulk, The Mandalorian), and ARDEN MYRIN (Free Bert, The Righteous Gemstones)

releases.title: Frequency of Fear
releases.synopsis: In September 2024, a covert Israeli operation took aim at decimating Islamist militant group Hezbollah, in which thousands of pagers and walkie-talkies in the possession of its operatives exploded simultaneously in Lebanon.

releases.title: Gentle by Birth
releases.synopsis: After her 23-year-old brother dies of an overdose, filmmaker Doree Simon Hatfield investigates the stigma she believes blocked his access to treatment and support. Her search takes her from her family’s living room to harm reduction sites, music festivals, and the halls of the Pennsylvania Capitol, where she meets experts working to change how addiction is understood and treated. But as her own fear and stigma around drugs begin to dissolve, Doree makes a radical choice to try them herself—transforming the film from a dissection of her brother’s addiction into a provocative reckoning that threatens her family’s fragile healing.

releases.title: Too Much Light Makes the Baby Go Blind
releases.synopsis: The NHS Production of Too Much Light Makes the Baby Go Blind is an ensemble-driven, high-octane theatrical experience where the cast attempts to perform 30 short 1-2 minute plays in a strict 60-minute timeframe. Maintained by an onstage digital clock, the performance functions as a living experiment where actors play themselves in the immediate present. There are no traditional characters, no times where the ensemble is off stage, and no fourth wall.

releases.title: El club de la seducción
releases.synopsis: The film follows two men with opposing personalities whose lives unexpectedly cross paths. Driven by a debt, parties, romances, and impulsive decisions, they find themselves caught up in a series of chaotic situations that blend humor, action, and romance.

releases.title: È andata così
releases.synopsis: Cecilia, a determined mother of two with three failed relationships behind her, faces an unexpected crisis and turns to the three fathers of her children - Christophe, her first love and daughter’s father; Guido, her son’s father and former manager turned rider; and Tony, her estranged ex-husband and self-styled music manager - for support.

releases.title: Light Memories
releases.synopsis: In the family of photographer-turned-filmmaker Misha Vallejo no one ever talks about his grandfather. He only hears about him for the first time as an adult, thanks to an abandoned photo collection. Who was this shadow? And what legacy looms over the family? In his debut film Light Memories, Vallejo shows how the effects of neglect can persist across generations.

releases.title: Tootsie Doomsday
releases.synopsis: When the "Tootsie Virus" spreads globally, it compels men everywhere to fall in love with one another, triggering an unprecedented crisis of a severe shortage of straight men.

releases.title: The Whores Feast
releases.synopsis: Filmed during a shared harvest dinner with organizers and collaborators, The Whores Feast brings together Ceyenne Doroshow of G.L.I.T.S., Victoria Von Blaque of Trans Equity Consulting, Lisa 张小华 of Red Canary Song, and Amalia Valentine of Decrim NY. Their conversation lingers over nourishment, labor, chosen family, honoring the collective practices of care that sustain communities through ongoing precarity.

releases.title: Through the Eyes of Sera Flynn
releases.synopsis: When a group of five soon-to-graduate high school seniors skip the last day of school, attempting to make it the best day possible, they slowly realize one of them is hiding a deep emotional struggle behind what seems to be the face of a happy teen.

releases.title: Delivery Girl
releases.synopsis: Yao's boyfriend (29) is murdered while she's delivering an order for her Chinese restaurant. Now alone, she has to run the restaurant while dealing with the indifference of the police, the municipality, the entire city, and the deceased's parents, who want to take over the business. While coping with grief and the mystery surrounding the crime, Yao also experiences a newfound freedom that leads her to seek a less solitary and more exciting life, trying to become increasingly involved with this new world she still has to discover.

releases.title: Douvina
releases.synopsis: The film is a silent invitation to contemplation: on the winding paths of preserving memory, on what slips through our fingers in the present, and on our own place in the face of the departure of those we love, the disappearance of places, and the subtle marks we leave along the way.

releases.title: Hidden Colors 6: The Culture of Resistance
releases.synopsis: Hidden Colors 6 examines overlooked stories of Black American resistance, resilience, innovation and cultural survival.

releases.title: Rua 16
releases.synopsis: Fed up with constant power outages caused by the utility company's negligence, the residents of Rua 16 decide to organize a collective effort to install solar panels and take control of their own electricity supply. However, internal disagreements and the fear of retaliation threaten the community's unity - even before the first panel is installed.

releases.title: Pianke
releases.synopsis: The story of a young German boy and his father who befriend a Jewish family during WWII.

releases.title: Pūtaringa
releases.synopsis: Follow Pete as he explores the struggles of an overwhelming new environment and finds comfort in the small things that remind him of home.

releases.title: Don Abel: The Main Rooster From Yerbabuena, Jalisco, Mexico Against the World
releases.synopsis: In 1976, Don Abel, a corrupt but conflicted Mexican intelligence agent known as El Mero Gallo, is recruited by the CIA to eliminate a defecting Communist leader hiding in California. What begins as a routine mission quickly spirals into chaos, forcing Don Abel to face his own morality, ambition, and the true weight of his choices. A darkly satirical espionage thriller, Don Abel collides faith, loyalty, and betrayal in a story where no one walks away clean.

releases.title: The Policewoman
releases.synopsis: Former Victoria detective Narelle Fraser investigated some of Australia’s highest profile crimes. Her easy manner allowed her to gain rapport with many perpetrators, leading to their convictions… but it all came at a price. The constant daily exposure to horrific crime had a cumulative effect on Narelle’s mental health. She hid the effects for 27 years, but after suffering panic and amnesia, she received a diagnosis of PTSD, which forced her discharge from the Police. THE POLICEWOMAN illustrates the crimes that caused her descent into hell, and the battle to claw her way out. Narelle’s positive outcome in this true crime feature will demystify the stigma of mental health and speak to millions of first responders around the world.

releases.title: Eye to Eye
releases.synopsis: Tyler wakes up with the ability to read others’ minds upon making eye contact, but must immediately say their thoughts out loud. Now he and his friend Brick must get rid of the curse.

releases.title: The Dungeon: West Virginia Penitentiary
releases.synopsis: Ever since I was a kid I have been interested in the paranormal and now as an adult I can finally discover the truth for myself. I visited the West Virginia Penitentiary in Moundsville, West Virginia to see what I could find. Who knew that on my first investigation, I would get far more than I ever bargained for.

releases.title: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B
releases.synopsis: Pessoal do Ceará - Lado A Lado B explores the music scene from the Brazilian state of Ceará between 1969 and 1979 - a period marked by the military coup, the implementation of the AI-5 decree, and intense socio-political ferment. The focus is on the "Pessoal do Ceará" movement, which brought artists such as Fagner, Ednardo, and Belchior to prominence. Taking the 1973 álbum as a starting point, the work examines its common association with these three singers - even though, in reality, only Ednardo (alongside Rodger and Teti) is featured on it.

releases.title: Journey to the End of the Ego
releases.synopsis: The scene is the almost mythical landscape of Ben Loyal, one of Scotland's most remote mountains towering over the Arctic Ocean. The cliff is one of the finest sweeps of clean unclimbed rock to be found anywhere in the land. The climber is the thought-provoking controversial live-wire, who goes by the name of Franco Cookson. This is the epic story of the UK's most dangerous trad route and the 105 days of climbing it took to realise one man's dream; 'Nothing is Lost' E12 7a.

releases.title: Life Sure Is Sweet
releases.synopsis: Two years in the making, "Life Sure Is Sweet" is a independent coming-of-age snowboard documentary produced by the creative collective TDI (Technically Doing It). Featuring an all-Black and Brown crew of riders travelling and filming across the globe, the film moves beyond high-level action sports progression to explore deep themes of cultural identity, community, lifelong friendship, and charting your own path in the mountains.

releases.title: Behind The Passion
releases.synopsis: Qatar 2022 was the most expensive World Cup in history. Behind the spectacle sat a system built on bribery and forced labor, one that consumed the men who built it, and a governing body with every reason not to look. In Rosario, Argentina, a human rights organization shaped by the horrors of its own country's past set out to make sure someone did.

releases.title: Mono No Aware
releases.synopsis: The spiritual journey of a human being -an idealized model, a prophet of purity- on the path toward the Nietzschean Übermensch, reinterpreted through a contemporary lens. From the social darkness of the Camel, taking its steps through a desert of melancholy and solitude, to the verbal force of the Lion, reflected in its absolute moral freedom and freedom of thought, up to the birth of the Child, the very manifesto of innocence, ruled by instinct, physical ecstasy, a continuous search for the Self, and constant linguistic experimentation.

releases.title: The Fourth Cut
releases.synopsis: Planning a heist.

releases.title: High End: The Watch Theft Ring
Dear Debbie
releases.synopsis:
Sometimes, enough is enough…

Debbie Mullen is losing it. For years, she has compiled all of her best advice into her column, Dear Debbie, where the wives of New England come for sympathy and neighborly advice. Through her work, Debbie has heard from countless women who are ignored, belittled, or even abused by their husbands. And Debbie does her best to guide them in the right direction. Or at least, she did.

These days, Debbie’s life seems to be spiraling out of control. She just lost her job. Something strange is happening with her teenage daughters. And her husband is keeping secrets, according to the tracking app she installed on his phone. Now, Debbie’s done being the bigger person.

She’s done being reasonable and practical. It’s time to take her own advice.

And now it’s time for payback against all the people in her life who deserve it the most.

releases.title: Persona
releases.synopsis:
**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

A feral shut-in discovers a disturbing internet porn video of what seems to be herself. A seance of coked-up artists summons unearthly forces in a studio apartment. The staircase of an exurban marketing company descends endlessly beneath the earth. 

In Aoife Josie Clements’ electric, nightmarish, intricately layered novel, the impossibility of goodness crowds in upon two young trans women barely surviving on sex work and zero-hours contracts. Below the familiar evils of capitalism and the bottomless depths of internet culture, a darker horror awaits. What curse follows these women? What are they escaping? What are they running towards?

releases.title: KYOTO lo sguardo del drago
releases.synopsis: Un fantasy thriller, come in un film, dal lusso degli yacht di Portofino ai ruderi di un antico castello in Giappone. Il prezioso pugnale del samurai demone Nobunaga è scomparso. Michele, geniale decifratore di codici segreti, Alexander, affascinante milionario irlandese, Gretel, eclettica signora, e Yoshida, investigatore privato, sono i fantastici quattro che indagano per svelare il mistero in un crescendo da vivere minuto dopo minuto: gli azzardi, i ninja, l'onore e l'amicizia, l'amore e la morte. Tragica e fiabesca, cinica e poetica, una storia dura ammantata di dolcezza ed elegante ironia fino alla spietata soluzione.

releases.title: The Man Who Vanished
releases.synopsis:
**What would you become  if no one could see you?**

A gripping psychological thriller of invisibility, obsession, and power. Deep within Egypt, a discovery changes everything. When I encounter something never meant to be found, my world fractures. I vanish from sight—but not from consequence. Liberation mutates into obsession, freedom into a mind slipping beyond control.

Unseen, I move through the world’s shadows—navigating criminal networks, exposing hidden conspiracies, unearthing truths buried for centuries. Invisibility becomes more than an ability: it becomes temptation, weapon, and curse.

Each step deeper into the unseen erodes the boundaries between justice and transgression, control and compulsion. But the greatest danger is not the enemies I pursue. It is the darkness awakening within me. As curiosity hardens into obsession, morality fractures.

Some hungers leave scars you cannot see. And when power begins to consume rather than empower, survival becomes a battle not only against those who hunt me—but against the consequences of everything I have done. 

The Man Who Vanished is a gripping psychological thriller fused with political intrigue, conspiracies and espionage suspense. Relentless tension meets psychological depth in a story about invisibility, obsession, and the devastating cost of crossing unseen lines.

Perfect for readers who love:

✔ Psychological thrillers
✔ Political and conspiracy thrillers
✔ Espionage and spy fiction
✔ Dark suspense and moral dilemmas
✔ High-stakes international intrigue

Fans of high-tension, mind-bending thrillers and stories of identity, secrecy, and psychological descent will be captivated by its atmosphere, intensity, and escalating suspense. 
Are you ready to vanish into the unseen?

Notice: Contains mature themes and strong scenes intended for mature readers.

releases.title: Titanium, The Life & Memoirs Of Toby Ti Mustard
releases.synopsis: Titanium: Life of X is a raw, visionary memoir by ordained minister and creative leader Toby Ti Mustard. This spiritual autobiography traces a journey of awakening, reincarnation, and resilience — a life forged in silence, shaped by struggle, and elevated by purpose. Set against the backdrop of Ross County, Ohio, Toby’s story unfolds through mystical insight, personal transformation, and a calling to serve. Titanium is not just a book — it’s a declaration of identity, a spiritual blueprint, and a testament to the unbreakable force of becoming.

releases.title: The Beeston Genesis
releases.synopsis: A historical and analytical study examining the role of Robert William Felkin in the formation and codification of modern Western Tarot systems. The paper situates Felkin’s work within the intellectual and social context of Beeston, Nottinghamshire, and traces how these early influences informed later Golden Dawn Tarot structures.

releases.title: My Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Dad
releases.synopsis: This work serves as the primary case study for Sir Jacob Kristopher Anders' research into Digital Provenance and Media Ethics (Ref: Wikidata Q138334536).

releases.title: A Good Person
releases.synopsis:
Lillian and Henry have been enjoying each other’s company, especially in bed. Even though Lillian’s best friend calls it “situationship,” Lillian is determined to lock Henry down—and she has a plan. She’ll be the best, most accommodating version of herself until he falls in love with her. But when Henry blindsides Lillian with a breakup, Lillian exacts revenge by performing a drunken hex on him.

Lillian expects Henry to come crawling back to her. What she doesn’t quite anticipate is becoming a prime suspect in his murder case when he’s found dead. As Lillian grapples with the loss of her sort-of-boyfriend, she’s hit with another reckoning: That Henry had a long-term girlfriend he also left behind.

Desperate to control the narrative, clear her name, and assume her rightful place as Henry’s mourning girlfriend, Lillian’s pursuit of the truth will throw her into a dangerous tailspin.

releases.title: Tiny Steps Giant Leaps
releases.synopsis:
The book '**Tiny Steps Giant Leaps**' was written by the author **Chowdhury Tauhid Mahmud** aka Radi. He has expertise in teaching children for around two decades. He came up with this book, so that readers can come back to the habit of reading books and naturally stays away from screen time as much as possible. 
The book is unique because the readers have to read and write lots of activities which will help to boost their creativity.

releases.title: The Escape Game
releases.synopsis:
**It’s all fun and games until someone ends up dead.**

Six months ago, season four of The Escape Game ended in horror when contestant Alicia Angelos was found murdered on set.

Now season five is underway, and new contestants are ready to put their skills to the test solving the show's trickiest escape rooms. There's Adi, the cryptographer; Carter, the math whiz; Beck, the wannabe game master; and . . . Sierra Angelos, the girl who got away with her sister’s murder. Or so everyone believes.

But Sierra’s not just here to win. She’s here for justice.

When the contestants begin uncovering clues that hint at the identity of Alicia’s true killer, it becomes clear that the stakes aren’t high just in this competition—they’re deadly. If these teens want to win—and survive—the game, they must solve the biggest mystery of all: who killed Alicia Angelos?

releases.title: In the Periphery of It All
गुनहग़ार (Gunehgar)
releases.synopsis:
"क्या कोई गुनाह इतना बड़ा हो सकता है कि खुदा की रहमत कम पड़ जाए?"
यह कहानी है फ़ैज़ की, जिसके लिए एक थप्पड़ सिर्फ एक पल की बेइज्जती नहीं थी, बल्कि उसके पूरे वजूद की हार बन गई थी. ज़ोया से किया गया वह इंतिक़ाम उसे एक ऐसे मोड़ पर ले आता है, जहाँ मंज़िल अब कोई मंज़िल नहीं, बल्कि खुद की तलाश है.
यह महज़ एक प्रेम कहानी नहीं है, बल्कि नफरत की आग से शुरू होकर सजदों की शांति तक पहुँचने वाला एक गहरा सफ़र है. फ़ैज़ की गलतियाँ उसे ऐसी गलियों में ले जाती हैं जहाँ पछतावा ही उसका इकलौता साथी है

releases.title: Of Darkness and Desecration
releases.synopsis:
I could cling to hope or hate…
That night, I chose hope.
But I kept hate close by.
Just in case.

The second novel in the Harbingers of Agatharr series continues as our heroes converge.

Celeste, the Herald of Valitharr, races toward the ancient spellweaver stronghold of Lirathmar. But the divine being who whispers in her mind has been called to stand before the Pantheon, and Celeste worries she won’t survive the journey without him.

Caelen, a timid peasant, blames himself for the horrors that have befallen his loved ones and vows never to be paralyzed by fear again. His newfound eagerness finds him in possession of a powerful, ancient ability that threatens to sunder his mind unless he learns to control it.

Brynna, a hardened blacksmith, has sworn to protect Caelen and return him to the remnants of his family in Mossby. But in a world cursed with magic, even the simplest task can be marred by danger.

Their paths have merged, but how do they trust those they barely know when death lurks in every shadow?

releases.title: Love and Other Curses
releases.synopsis:
For the Kingdom. For the magic. And for love . . .

Aurelia Wycherley has found someone to tether her magic to – her enigmatic former enemy, Jules Nightly. Now, they are heading off to coven college to learn advanced magic. But they are also on a secret to discover the Lost Quarter of the college, create their own coven of twelve and try to discover a way to bring back the Old Magic. 

When malevolent magic interrupts their first night at college, Aurelia and Jules discover that Jonathan and his coven of untethered witches has escaped and now they are after her magic, curse and all… 

Can they save the magic and the world - or will Aurelia lose her magic for good?

Prepare for balls, late-night study groups, hidden mysteries, a heist, the return of old foes, and a lot more kissing!

releases.title: Oceanforged
releases.synopsis:
*From the bestselling author of The Grandest Bookshop in the World comes the second instalment of an epic fantasy adventure series in the tradition of Skandar and Percy Jackson.* 

Guided by a mysterious message, Cori, Tarn and Jem sail north to meet the secretive Loyalists, who will help them on their quest for the Oceanforged Armour.

Instead, the Loyalists warn of a looming disaster. Unless Cori can master all the powers of the Champions before it strikes, Aquinta will be doomed.

The Loyalists believe that a piece of armour may be hidden in Mutemount. But sea monsters once lurked in those waters, and no one who has travelled near the silent island in the last century has ever returned…

releases.title: The Writers Retreat
releases.synopsis:
**A wickedly twisty and atmospheric thriller set at a writers' retreat in the South of France, The Writers Retreat is Knives Out meets Anna Downes’ The Safe Place from an exciting new voice in the thriller/mystery space.**

Welcome to The Writers Retreat – a creative haven for writers to hone their plotlines and sharpen their characters while soaking up the Provençal atmosphere. But this year’s retreat offers something different, as real-life blurs with fiction, and suspense isn't contained to the page.

Kat Hale is a bestselling Australian author crumbling under the pressure of writing her second novel. On a whim, she has fled to a writers retreat in the South of France run by internationally acclaimed author Helen Thorne. What Kat hopes will be two blissfully uninterrupted weeks to focus on her writing in anonymity quickly turns into something more sinister, when Kat begins to suspect that Helen isn't quite as perfect as everyone seems to believe.

Will Kat’s drive to uncover the truth about Helen be any match for Helen’s desire to hold onto her career, her reputation and her writing retreat, or is Kat at risk of falling victim to a more dangerous climax?

releases.title: The Radiant Dark
releases.synopsis:
***Arrival meets Wild Dark Shore in this captivating novel that follows a family for over fifty years—a bold and compassionate exploration of the universe around us and what it truly means to be human.***

It’s March 1980, and Carol Girard and her husband are living an ordinary life in a small town in the Adirondacks. They have just had their first child, and though Carol is struggling with the challenges of new motherhood, her future seems clear. Until something extraordinary happens: an inexplicable flickering of light in the sky, which is ultimately determined to be communication from intelligent life on another planet. But these beings are eleven light-years away, and nothing is known about them other than the fact that they seem to know we exist too. And so begins a decades-long exchange of messages with this mysterious, faraway civilization.

As humanity reels from a shifting understanding of its place in the universe, we follow the stories of the Girard family: Carol, whose fascination with this other life sparks a desperate search for spiritual meaning; Michael, her loyal son, who finds solace not in the stars above his head but in the ground beneath his feet; and Ro, Carol’s bright and ambitious daughter, whose childhood goal to work in interstellar communication will evolve into something far grander.

Tracing five decades of love, loss, ambition, and self-discovery, *The Radiant Dark* is a stunning examination of a family navigating their lives with the knowledge that we are not alone.

releases.title: The Academy V

Wings of Brotherhood: A Journey Between Two Air Forces by Badrul Hassan Khan is an extraordinary Pakistan Air Force memoir that takes readers inside the cockpit, command rooms, and corridors of power across South Asia and the Gulf. From fierce dogfights in West Pakistan during the 1965 war to the heartbreaking betrayals of 1971, this PAF pilot biography book reveals the courage, loyalty, and sacrifices of men who shaped aerial warfare in the region.

Wing Commander Badrul Hassan Khan, one of the rare officers to have fought in both the Indo Pak wars, offers an unfiltered look at how politics, pride, and patriotism collided in the skies. As he moves from the Pakistan Air Force to help build Bahrain’s Air Wing from scratch, readers witness the remarkable evolution of two nations’ military identities.

Packed with gripping battle scenes, behind the scenes accounts of Air Marshal Noor Khan’s leadership, and insider perspectives on military intelligence, this military memoir book captures a defining era of aviation and regional geopolitics. Whether you’re a history enthusiast, a student of Pakistan Air Force history, or simply drawn to tales of valor and vision, Wings of Brotherhood offers an unmatched journey through war, duty, and brotherhood.

A powerful addition to collections of books on the Indo Pak war 1965 and 1971, this is the definitive Pakistan Air Force memoir, a story of ambition, betrayal, and resilience that continues to shape South Asia’s skies.

Born in 1926, Opal Lee grew up in a racially divided America and dedicated her life to overcoming the obstacles presented therein. A lifelong educator, Ms. Opal has been a community activist all her life, and would take on the movement to celebrate and commemorate Juneteenth not just as a holiday, but as a symbol of comprehensive freedom for all people.

Ms. Opal’s life personifies the fight for everyday freedom that leads to lasting change. As the Grandmother of Juneteenth says, “There is so much more to do.”

releases.title: To Catch a Fascist
releases.synopsis:
A searing, provocative investigation into the rise of white nationalist and neo-Nazi movements in the United States, centered on the anti-fascist groups working to expose and stop these hateful factions.

Demonized as “extremist” by conservatives and liberals alike, “antifa” became a bogeyman during Donald Trump’s first term. But few Americans understood the dangerous work antifa was doing to disrupt and unmask a new generation of white supremacists or listened when antifa sounded the alarm about these white supremacists taking positions of power. Now this underground network of militant anti-fascists is determined to stop the rising tide of fascism in America. No matter the cost.

In the tradition of in-the-room investigative classics such as The Smartest Guys in the Room and Bad Blood, To Catch a Fascist follows different factions of antifascists as they work to unmask hateful extremists before they commit devastating acts of violence. With searing detail and exclusive reporting, To Catch a Fascist paints a vivid picture of the stakes in this ongoing, often unseen war between opposite ends of the political spectrum, highlighting the scrappy resourcefulness and resilience of anti-fascist movements against their increasingly violent adversaries. Utilizing razor-sharp storytelling and eye-opening insight, this timely and necessary book reveals the human cost, moral dilemmas, and unwavering determination involved in fighting white supremacy.

Both a call to action and a pulse-raising look at the powerful work being done to combat today’s gravest threat to democracy, To Catch a Fascist will inspire you to fight for your community.

releases.title: Intoxicated Ways of Knowing
releases.synopsis:
Intoxicating substances can be found lurking in every corner of modern life, and Matthew Perkins-McVey’s pathbreaking book offers the untold story of how they were implicated in shifting perceptions of embodiment found in the emerging sciences of the body and mind in late-nineteenth-century Germany. Their use in this experimental context gave rise to a dynamic conception of the subject within the scientific, psychological, philosophical, and sociological milieu of the era. The history of the modern biological subject, Perkins-McVey argues, turns on “intoxicated ways of knowing.”
 
Intoxicated Ways of Knowing identifies the state of intoxication as a tacit form of thinking and knowing with the body. Intoxicants force us to feel, intervening directly in our perceptional awareness, and, Perkins-McVey contends, they bring latent conceptual associations into the foreground of conscious thought, engendering new ways of knowing the world. The book unfurls how intoxicants affected nineteenth-century German science and how, ultimately, the connection between mental life and intoxication is taken up in the works of Friedrich Nietzsche, Max Weber, and Sigmund Freud, bringing the biological subject out of the lab and into the worlds of philosophy, psychoanalysis, sociology, and politics.

releases.synopsis:
Today, we operate in an environment of records abundance, with far more documentation created than can reasonably be kept. Thoughtful selection and appraisal is both a balancing act and a vital skill for modern archivists. Selecting and Appraising Archives and Manuscripts is a concise introduction to the theory and practice of archival selection and appraisal, offering practical tools for principled work.

While much of the existing literature on appraisal is theoretical, this book focuses on practical ideas that are grounded in best practices, informed by the past, and aspirationally moving the profession forward. Divided into six chapters, topics include policy development, ethics and strategies for collecting repositories, tools and methods for analyzing records, appraisal and acquisition in institutional settings, and more. Guidance is centered on intentional collecting, adherence to professional values, and responsible stewardship, and covers a variety of formats.

This volume can be read in a linear way or used as a quick reference in real-life scenarios. Read it in its entirety, or jump to specific chapters as your situation warrants. This volume will help readers feel confident in making thoughtful collection- building decisions.

Shah Jahan by Usman Ali Shah Jahan is a thoughtful fantasy drama book that brings together emotion, depth, and human experience in a way that feels both real and timeless. The story unfolds with calm intensity, showing how people live, love, and survive in moments of struggle and silence. Each scene feels natural and alive, written with care and purpose, reflecting the light and shadows of human nature. The author captures both the cruelty of power and the quiet strength of hope, allowing the reader to see how art can express what words often cannot. Shah Jahan is more than a modern drama book; it is an honest portrayal of what it means to be human, to feel pain, and still choose compassion. 

The writing is simple yet powerful, offering reflections that stay long after the book is closed. Readers who enjoy drama novels books and contemporary fiction books will find in it a voice that speaks to shared experiences and emotions. It is a story that values truth over show, meaning over noise, and hope over despair. Shah Jahan stands as a reminder that even in the hardest times, art can heal, stories can connect us, and humanity continues to seek understanding.

releases.title: Ubay
releases.synopsis: *Ubay is an observer from Astreon, a planet of perfect order, calm logic, and no emotion. Her mission: study the strange, contradictory beings on a blue world called Earth. She lands in the remote White Mountains of Crete, expecting to remain invisible. Instead, an elderly couple finds her, feeds her, and gives her work in their family taverna. As she works, she files meticulous reports on human behaviour, from inexplicable kindness to stubborn hope. But the observer is changing. When her identity is threatened, Ubay must choose between completing her mission and protecting the family who taught her what it means to care. This is a quiet, philosophical first-contact story about belonging, empathy, and the limits of logic, and it is the third volume in a trilogy that includes Ari's Taverna and Unheard Voice.*

releases.title: Burn Down Master’s House
releases.synopsis:
As turmoil simmers within a divided nation, smoke from another blaze begins to rise. Sparked by individual acts of resistance among those enslaved across the American South, their seemingly disparate rebellions fuel a singular inferno of justice, connecting them in ways quiet at times, explosive at others. As these flames rise, so will they.

Luke, quick-witted and literate, and Henri, a man with a strong and defiant spirit, forge an unbreakable bond at a Virginia plantation called Magnolia Row. Both seek escape from unimaginable cruelty. And sure as the fires of hell, Luke and Henri will leave their mark, sparking resistance among the lives they touch…

One is Josephine, a young, sharp, and observant girl who wields silence as her greatest weapon. A witness to Luke and Henri’s resilience, she listens, watches, waits for the moment to make her move.

Then there is Charity Butler, her husband a formerly enslaved man who proved his ferocity as a young boy standing alongside Josephine. At his encouragement, Charity fights for her freedom in court and wins – only to battle a deeply unjust system designed to destroy the life they’ve built.

And finally, there is Nathaniel, who ruthlessly exploits other Black people and mirrors the cruelty of the white men who, like him, are enslavers. A perversion of the system of slavery, his fragile and contradictory rule will become a catalyst of its own.

Inspired by the true stories of the profoundly courageous men and women who dared to fight back, Burn Down Master’s House is a singular tour de force of a novel—breathtaking in scope, compassion, and a timeliness that speaks powerfully to our present era.

releases.title: Whidbey
releases.synopsis:
Birdie Chang didn’t know anything about Whidbey Island when she chose it, only that it was about as far away as she could get from her own life. She’s a woman on the run, desperate for an escape from the headlines back home and the look of concern in her girlfriend’s eyes—and from Calvin Boyer, the man who abused her as a child and who’s now resurfaced. On her way, she has an unnerving encounter with a stranger on the ferry who offers her a proposition, a sinister solution, a plan for revenge.

But Birdie isn’t the only girl Calvin harmed back then. There’s also Linzie King, a former reality TV star who recently wrote all about it in her bestselling memoir. Though the two women have never met, their stories intertwine. Once Birdie arrives on Whidbey, she finally cracks the book’s spine, only to find too much she recognizes in its pages. Soon after, on the other side of the country, Calvin’s loving mother, Mary-Beth, receives a shocking phone call from the police: her only son has been murdered.

Calvin’s death sets into motion a series of events that sends each woman on a desperate search for answers. A complex whodunnit told from alternating points of view, Whidbey is searingly perceptive and astonishingly original. Exploring the long reach of violence and our flawed systems of incarceration and rehabilitation, this is a tense and provocative debut that’s sure to incite crucial questions about the pursuit of justice and who has real power over a story: the one who lives it, or the one who tells it?

But what she really wants to talk about are unhinged thoughts on gender, Karl Marx, Zionism, and her two great disappointing loves: an estranged trans son and a long-lost best friend whose betrayal haunts Barbara still. As she descends further into delirium and illness, Barbara finds herself in a nightmare from which she cannot escape, and her circumstances put her on a crash course with these intimates—or are they avenging nemeses?—once again.

releases.title: Not in My House
releases.synopsis: A 1v4 home-invasion party game. The Thief shrinks the family and sucks them into his gun while he robs the house. The Residents set silly traps, kick him flat and call the police before he banks $5,000. Then the lights go out: flashlights against night vision.

releases.title: Bigger Bang
releases.synopsis: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

releases.title: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
releases.synopsis:
Out of the highly successful Don Bradman simulation series comes Don Bradman Cricket JR, the hard-hitting arcade cricket game. Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot, smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

Complete the Bradman Challenge Round and you'll unlock Sir Donald Bradman himself as the captain of the Australian side, along with the Bradman vs Water Tank Mini Game. Easy to pick up…impossible to put down.

releases.title: Prehistoric Pit
releases.synopsis: Prehistoric Pit is a bullet heaven roguelite with voxel graphics. The player controls one of nine dinosaurs in an arena that fills with waves of Ice Age mammals, while weapons fire automatically. Between waves the player picks upgrades, limited to four weapon slots per run. Every weapon evolves into a second form at level 30 with its matching relic. A run lasts about 30 minutes across volcanic stages. Each dinosaur has its own exclusive starting weapon, active ability and passive; eight of them are unlocked through in-run challenges.

releases.title: A Little Faraway
releases.synopsis: Some days, you just need a quiet place to be. Come to a little island far away, where you can wander at your own pace, watch the sky change, and discover little wonders. No rush, no expectations, nothing you need to do. Just a beautiful place to stay awhile.

releases.title: Spice Pound
releases.synopsis: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

releases.title: Italian Street Food Simulator
releases.synopsis: Run your own street food stand in a lively Italian coastal town. Prepare Italian street food, serve walk-up and seated customers, manage supplies and equipment and grow your business day by day in this first-person cooking simulator.

releases.title: Drain the Galaxy
releases.synopsis: Thousands of space dwarves vs. one planet. The planet loses. Land, strip it bare in short runs with pickaxes, lasers and missiles, haul the loot home and grow a huge upgrade tree. You can't lose. You can only get richer

releases.title: Phone Shop Simulator
releases.synopsis: Build and run your own phone shop! Stock phones and accessories, design your displays, set prices and serve customers. Manage your money and turn a small store into a thriving business in Phone Shop Simulator.

releases.title: Continuum
releases.synopsis: A generation ship roguelite where no one aboard survives the journey. Travel the stars one world at a time as each generation shapes your ship and writes a new chapter in the chronicle.

releases.title: Zone L.O.S.T.
releases.synopsis: Your body is your weakness. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

releases.title: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts
releases.synopsis: A 14 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

releases.title: Derail
releases.synopsis: Derail is a horror anomaly game where instead of spotting anomalies you have to cleanse them with you holy camera to escape the loop.

releases.title: Last Inspection
releases.synopsis: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

releases.title: Rules of the Inn
releases.synopsis: A Japanese horror-mystery. In an inn room at the edge of the afterlife, you follow a rule added nightly and judge what slips in; by morning, open the ledger for the truth. The rules never lie, but some nights something not in them arrives disguised as something that is. Obey, or doubt? Mouse only.

releases.title: The Goddess Told Me: Steal That Loaf of Bread
releases.synopsis: A fantasy adventure about a five-millimetre ant sent by the goddess Kona to steal a seventy-two-centimetre loaf of bread. Players navigate a world built around differences of scale, crumbs and narrow passages.

releases.title: Gildoria: Organize a Dragon's Hoard
releases.synopsis: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

releases.title: Offside Deal: Football At Any Costs
releases.synopsis: The match is only half the job. Build a squad that fits the way you want to play, keep the dressing room together and make the right calls when matchday arrives. Egos, rivalries and loyalties can make or break your season.

releases.title: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
releases.synopsis: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

releases.title: Scrolls of Alexandria: Tidy up the Lost Library
releases.synopsis: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria, reading the colour of 21 real ancient alphabets. Every cat guards one and won't let go until you pet it! Eat a golden apple for optional magic, or take a quiet afternoon in the stacks :)

releases.title: Soulstack
releases.synopsis: Idle card RPG on a table. Drag cards onto each other to do literally everything. 200+ weapon recipes (only ~40 are worth keeping), 140 pet evolutions, 12 prestige classes. Yet still feels like a Jira and Trello child.

releases.title: Next of Kin: Epiphany
releases.synopsis: Become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

releases.title: Dark Alley
releases.synopsis: A British detective has vanished in Kyoto. Step into Detective Bennett's shoes and uncover a mystery that reaches far beyond the Yakuza.

releases.title: Blue Check
releases.synopsis:
Blue Check is an experimental psychological horror.

Experience the life of a young woman who has just moved into a new apartment. Explore her everyday life through her computer. Play minigames, read the latest news, shop for new items to decorate your home, and, most importantly, chat with your friends!

Powered by AI-driven text generation, NPCs respond dynamically to your messages, making every conversation feel like a real chat. Enjoy the freedom of talking to characters who react to what you say... while it lasts...

But there's more to the girl's life than meets the eye. A dark secret lies beneath the surface, waiting to be uncovered.

Will you discover the truth?

releases.title: TerraLounge
releases.synopsis:
Players decorate and spend time in a terrarium, and play match-3 puzzles to earn currency to use in the terrarium. This currency is used to buy toys, decorations, music, and floors.

The game features 3 game modes: Endless, with procedurally generated boards; Story, hand-crafted levels across 5 worlds; Terrarium, where players decorate and spend time with slimes.

The intent of the game is to be a second screen, fish tank kind of game, where it exists with the player as a companion, but not draw attention to itself.

releases.title: Dialshift
releases.synopsis: Dialshift is a single-player score-attack arcade game played on a circular dial. Players control a continuously moving cursor with two directional inputs and time hit attempts against targets while maintaining combos and Stability. Seven modes vary the rules with directional targets, forced reversals, sustained holds, and multi-hit targets. Each mode has its own scores, ranks, and leaderboard.

releases.title: Swarm Harvest
releases.synopsis:
Congratulations, you're hired!
Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

releases.title: AJ's Anomaly
releases.synopsis: First-person anomaly horror. Play as Amelia Jalisco, a fashion designer investigating her gallery the night before a big exhibition. After months of exhausting work and a series of troubled business relationships, she may be starting to lose her mind.

releases.title: Ashen Legacy
releases.synopsis: Ashen Legacy is a fast-paced 2D Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Master intense combat, unleash powerful skills, defeat deadly monsters, and uncover the legacy buried within the ashes.

releases.title: Where the Seeds Fall
releases.synopsis: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

releases.title: 為人民服務: 無聲的文化反抗：當代華人影視中的借古諷今
releases.synopsis:
連線：黃瑞(中國國民黨三藩市分部行政副書記、『反支黑行動』串聯者)
近年國際流行文化與影視作品中，華人形象正經歷顯著重塑，由早期神秘武生或科技學霸，轉變為帶有威權色彩或科技間諜疑慮的角色，折射出國際輿論對政權威脅的警覺。
與此同時，影視創作正成為面對高壓環境的「無聲反抗」。
從串流平台熱播的古裝宮鬥劇，到刻意抽離政權符號的現代生活劇，乃至近期興起的AI生成諷刺短片，創作者運用借古諷今與寓言隱喻成功繞過言論審查，展現出民間強大的藝術創造力與批判韌性。
在政治現實層面，高層肅清與全方位數位監控更構成極權體制內部的疑懼氛圍。
影視作品所呈現的文化軟實力與隱喻批判，正與極權體制形成鮮明對比，成為觀察當代華人社會內部思潮與未來走向的重要窗口。
本集《為人民服務》，邀請在美青年黃瑞跟我們一起來聊聊。
